sources.title: WeMM-Embedding: WeChat Multi-Modal Embedding Technical Report
sources.snippet: In this work, we introduce WeMM-Embedding, a family of universal multimodal embedding models spanning 2B, 4B, and 9B scales. To build a strong and general-purpose multimodal embedding family, we devise a two-stage training strategy that progressively moves from broad multimodal alignment to finer-grained relevance learning.
